description: This file defines the IPlugin interface and related classes for plugin management in the Thunder framework, including lifecycle, notification, web, websocket, security, and authentication interfaces.

classes.name: IPlugin
classes.description: Main plugin interface with lifecycle and metadata methods.

classes.name: IPluginExtended
classes.description: Extended plugin interface with communication channel attachment methods.

classes.name: ICompositPlugin
classes.description: Interface for composite plugins with callback registration.

classes.name: IChannel
classes.description: Interface for raw data channel communication.

classes.name: ISecurity
classes.description: Interface for security validation and token management.

classes.name: IAuthenticate
classes.description: Interface for token creation and security officer retrieval.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Called on plugin load for setup with configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Called on plugin unload for cleanup.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Register a callback for plugin events.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming web request or websocket message.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Process web request and generate response.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handle incoming raw data on a channel.

methods.name: Outbound
methods.description: Send raw data over a channel.

methods.name: Allowed
methods.description: Check if a websocket upgrade or request is permitted.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Create a security token from data.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Get security interface for a token.
